svg.aria-label: Complete wiring diagram for variant B: a fused 12 volt rail feeds an MH-MINI-360 buck for the ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 and four identical door branches. Each branch runs from the rail through its own INA219 shunt into a DRV8871 H-bridge and motor. All four INA219s share one I2C bus on GPIO8 and GPIO9 at addresses 0x40, 0x41, 0x44 and 0x45; each bridge is driven by its own GPIO pair.
svg.title: Figure B1 - Variant B complete wiring diagram, four doors
svg.text: — single star point at BAT1 −, all ten returns land here
four identical branches: rail → shunt → bridge → motor.
Only the ESP pins and the INA219 address differ per door.
